question: How should pure-minded readers respond to the objection about consecration?
premises: The teacher has already shown the point.
Pure-minded readers are invited to examine it.
Some objectors raise a child-consecration analogy here.
inference: The objection about consecration must be examined in light of what has already been shown.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the child analogy is clarified in the next verse.
plain_english: I have already shown this, so let the pure-minded examine it. Here are those who object, saying it is like the consecration of a child.
